mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the real GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by more than 0.5% in a month and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a dovish monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dovish monetary policy with controlled inflation
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.
